topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Well, now, that’s a curious tale you’ve spun there, like a spider weaving gold into its web. I can see it, clear as a summer sky, this artist, eyes bright with the light of creation, wandering down the dusty path of a common alehouse, only to find their own brush strokes, forever etched upon another’s skin. The world sure does have a way of reaching out, doesn’t it? Like the first shoots pushing through the soil when the sun’s just right, warming the earth after a long, crisp winter. It’s a wonder, seeing one’s own dreams waking up on someone else’s arm, a living, breathing testament to the art that binds us all, even us humble farmers who toil in the fields. I reckon it’s a good day when the world surprises you with its own brand of magic.
